title: "What do you bring to the table?": your list of essentials, with one funny twist
summary: Answer "What do you bring to the table?" with a list of your real strengths, then one honest, funny last item. AI helps you write it.
why: Later's TikTok trends roundup, updated November 13, 2026, lists "What do you bring to the table?" as a new trend: people list the "essentials" they bring, with a joke twist at the end. It also lines up with holiday dinners and potlucks coming up.
steps: Use the main prompt to write a short list of what you bring, ending with a twist.
Film a simple clip: you setting a table, walking up to a dinner, or just looking at the camera.
Put the question at the top, then show the list one line at a time, with the twist last.
Use the original sound from the trend in your app, or any free-to-use audio.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Help me with a "What do you bring to the table?" video. I show a list of what I bring, one line at a time, and the last line is a funny twist. Here's a bit about me: [your personality, hobbies, what friends say about you]. Write 3 versions. Each has 4 or 5 lines, each line under six words. The first lines are real, kind strengths. The last line is an honest, self-aware joke, like "also: zero dishes". Keep it light, nothing about health, money or politics.

prompts.label: Variation: holiday dinner edition
prompts.text: Write a "What do you bring to the table?" list for a holiday dinner or potluck. I usually [what you really do at family dinners, for example: bring the same store-bought pie / tell long stories / take over the music]. Give me 3 lists of 5 lines, each line under six words, ending with a funny twist. Keep it warm and family-friendly.

prompts.label: Variation: for a friend or partner
prompts.text: Write a "What does [name] bring to the table?" list as a sweet, teasing tribute to my [friend / partner / sibling]. Here's what they're like: [three or four things]. Give me 3 lists of 4 or 5 lines, each under six words. Mostly kind and true, with one gentle joke at the end they'd laugh at.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run [type of business]. Write 3 "What do we bring to the table?" lists of 5 lines for a short video. The first lines are true things we offer, for example [two or three real strengths]. The last line is a light, self-aware joke about us, like "and way too many puns". Each line under six words. No invented results, prices or customer quotes.

tips: Hold the twist for the last line and give it an extra beat on screen.
Real strengths first. The joke lands better when the list sounds sincere.
A table, a plate or a dish in the shot makes the question feel literal and fun.
Only tag or show friends and family if they're happy to be in it.
